name: Spring Boot Actuator sensitive-endpoint exposure
attack_scenario: Attacker requests /actuator/heapdump, greps the dump for spring.datasource.password / signing keys, or POSTs to /actuator/env then /actuator/refresh (or hits /actuator/jolokia) to reconfigure the app and gain RCE.
negative_test_hint: request "GET /actuator/heapdump" and assert the server returns 404 or 401, not a heap dump or environment data

exemplar.explanation: Actuator endpoints such as env, heapdump and jolokia expose in-memory secrets, configuration properties and JMX access unauthenticated, up to remote code execution; the wildcard publishes all of them on the web port. Restricting exposure to health and info keeps monitoring useful without leaking sensitive internals.
